messages.subject: Question to function schedule
parts:
Hello,

Is it possible to simulate a working week with the schedule function?
In other words, work 5 days with 8 hours each day, 2 days weekend and then work 5 days with 8 hours each day, 2 days weekend and so on?

Thanks for the help

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Question to function schedule
parts:
On Sun, 10 May 2020 at 13:32, Krocki26412 <a.i.a-c...@t-online.de> wrote:
>
> Hello,
>
> Is it possible to simulate a working week with the schedule function?
> In other words, work 5 days with 8 hours each day, 2 days weekend and then work 5 days with 8 hours each day, 2 days weekend and so on?

Yes, see the example in help(schedule). In this case, your period is
the week (24*7 hours), and you have to define all the breaks during
the seven days.

Iñaki
